Name: Lovely Item Retexture
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/TVWAHsI.png[/img][/size]
[/font][color=#d9d2e9]This mod provides retextures (alternative sprites) for tons of stuff in the game such as:[/color][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#d9d2e9]
[/color][list]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]crops (objects, not growth stages)[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]artisan goods[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]forage[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]artifacts[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]minerals[/size][/color]
[*][color=#d9d2e9][size=5]food[/size][/color]
[/list][size=5]
I was roaming itch.io for a sprite I needed for a different mod when I stumbled across [url=https://misnina.itch.io/]Nina's[/url] lovely profile! She had so many cute things, and one of the items she shared was this huge set of retextures for Stardew. I reached out and asked if I could turn it into an actual mod and she agreed so here we are! 

[i][b][color=#d9d2e9]Note: the following items do [u]not[/u] currently have retextures:
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][i][b][color=#d9d2e9]Golden Relic[/color][/b][/i][/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][i][b][color=#d9d2e9]Tree Fruit[/color][/b][/i][/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][i][b][color=#d9d2e9]Animal items (like milk, eggs etc)[/color][/b][/i][/size][/font]
[/list][/color][/b][/i]
I spent ages on the config menu though so you can pick and choose whatever you'd like! 

Nina's sprites are a lovely twist on the vanilla art (hence the mod name) and you should totally go check her out at the links below!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c8QF6DK.png[/img]﻿
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/80501733]Nina[/url] for the sprites for this mod! You can find her on itchio [url=https://misnina.itch.io/]HERE[/url] and on Mastodon [url=https://mastodon.art/@misnina]HERE[/url]. She also does commissions so be sure to visit to see her lovely artwork.

AND a big thank you to the SDV modding discord community - y'all are so lovely and supportive.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/4JQyssp.png[/img][/size]

[size=5]For the full list check out my user page on Nexus [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/68674623?tab=user+files]HERE[/url]
[/size][/font]

Downloads.Description: Extract and place in mods folder. Edit config after running the game once using either Generic Mod Config Menu or a text editor

Manifest.Name: Lovely Item Retexture
Manifest.Description: New sprites for various items in the game like crops, forage, artisan goods, food and minerals!
